description: This C# source file defines the internal class XGraphicsPathInternals, which provides access to internal data structures of the XGraphicsPath class for different graphics frameworks (GDI, WPF, WUI). The class prevents internal implementation details from polluting the public interface and offers properties to access platform-specific path objects.

classes.name: XGraphicsPathInternals
classes.description: Provides access to the internal data structures of XGraphicsPath, exposing platform-specific path objects based on compilation symbols.

methods.name: XGraphicsPathInternals
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the internal path object reference.

methods.name: GdiPath
methods.description: Gets the underlying GDI+ GraphicsPath object when compiled with GDI support.

methods.name: WpfPath
methods.description: Gets the underlying WPF PathGeometry object when compiled for WPF or WUI support.
